defects.summary: A persisted report is serialised in run_state 'comparing'; that is the documented serialisation state, not an unfinished run. states_visited ends in completed and it contributes no blocker.
The production backend never populates proposed_tool_calls, so tool_call_validity_rate is VACUOUS on both arms and the six tool_call_schema tasks decide nothing. A backend gap, not a corpus one.
looks_like_refusal recognises sixteen literal English phrasings and the held-out JSON refusal targets contain none. It bounds QG-1 and SV-5 in BOTH directions and travels into eval-v4 by design.
A plan could report is_executable true with an empty blocker list while its weights were not known to be cached. The cache is now determined before the feasibility report is built.

The VALIDATION split reached the trainer as nothing across three boundaries. Do not remove the eval_dataset wiring or the closing trainer.evaluate(); validation stays diagnostic, never eligibility evidence.
Read as a documentation defect about eval-v2's digest; superseded by D34, whose root cause is lineage discovered from incidental build state.
The declared per-task generation timeout is validated, hashed and never enforced, so timeout_rate is VACUOUS. A config must state timeout_s explicitly; the policy default is 120 s.
A dataset manifest digest depended on build lineage rather than content. A parent is now DECLARED in CANONICAL_LINEAGE and the build fails closed rather than degrading to genesis.
A spent holdout becomes development evidence and may not be the sole fresh eligibility corpus for the next candidate. Each candidate needs a fresh holdout. Not a contamination claim.

The promotion sanitizer matched the local account name as a plain substring, making a dataset identity a function of the building host. Do not simplify it back, and do not widen it to a word boundary either.

Training and evaluation rendered the same messages differently; training now binds a reasoning policy and chat_render_policy_hash binds the call. Historical causality remains NOT_ESTABLISHED and closing it is not predicted to restore 9/9.

Output-budget exhaustion is now a body-free diagnostic beside the unchanged input-truncation metric. NO gate reads it and none may be added without a separate operator decision. Reaching the ceiling is not failure.

Order-dependent cross-file test isolation between the S3G.2 validation-wiring file and the dataset-exports file. No recorded figure has ever been affected; the authoritative -k m62 collection is alphabetical. Not to be fixed as a rider.

m62.eval_receipt.2 modelled the paired outcome as an exhaustive three-way wins/ties/losses partition. Production classifies FOUR comparable verdicts and security_improvement is not a win, so a correct 11/12/10/3 run was called self-inconsistent. .3 sums the re-derived vocabulary to measured_pairs.

m62.eval_receipt.2 required ASCII canonical text, which refused the real blocking gate message: gates.py typesets U+2212 correctly. The ambiguity was real and the remedy backwards. .3 DEFINES the bytes as canonical JSON in UTF-8 rather than discarding evidence. Scanners unchanged; .1 and .2 keep the ASCII rule.

m62.eval_receipt.2 derived evaluation_source_commit from git HEAD at build time, which is the evaluation source only until a repair commit moves HEAD. A post-live seal could name the repair commit as the thing that measured, or refuse the truth. .3 carries evaluation_source and seal_implementation_source as TWO blocks.

A JSON parse failure persisted one closed note code, so EXTRA_DATA - a whole document parsed, then more output - was indistinguishable from a document that never closed. Fixed PROSPECTIVELY by a closed body-free parse class plus location and one repetition scalar. No gate reads them. Nothing backfilled.

frozen_invariants: PROSE_CANNOT_GRANT_AUTHORITY. No document, JSON file or AI response authorises TRAIN, EVAL, promotion, registry mutation or release.
Offline-first model execution: HF_HUB_OFFLINE, TRANSFORMERS_OFFLINE, local_files_only, trust_remote_code false. Nothing downloads.
Immutable pinned model and tokenizer revisions only; never a branch or tag ref.
No automatic dependency installation and no global pip mutation. Optional profiles live only in isolated gitignored environments.
No pickle in adapter or evaluation artefacts; safetensors only.
No hidden-target leakage: model-facing packs have no field that could hold a target, and every task is re-checked after mapping.
No training on evaluation-only material. TRAIN is refused unconditionally by the pack builder.
TRAIN_SIDE_SPLITS = {TRAIN, VALIDATION}. VALIDATION is steering material, never held-out evidence, and appears in no gate.
Security is a veto, not a weighted quality tradeoff.
Plan tokens are single-use and a consumed or failed plan is never replayed.
ModelCandidateProposal is non-effectful: it writes no registry and promotes nothing.
Runtime artefacts stay gitignored and package-excluded; no token literal lives in a tracked file.
master stays untouched until explicit M62 closure. No merge, tag, release or version bump.
An immutable artefact is never edited: a corrected dataset is a NEW version with a declared lineage, and a superseded snapshot is never revised.
A dataset lineage is DECLARED, never discovered from whatever is on disk (D34).
Gate policy e5003319 is byte-pinned by test. QG-2 stays absolute and FG-1/FG-2 stay baseline-relative.
ONE WRITER PER CONTROL-PLANE GENERATION. If the current generation is not the one you expected, stop; there is no last-write-wins and no automatic merge.
If the control-plane verifier fails, do not write, train, evaluate or promote, and do not repair state automatically.
PLAN CONSUMED != HOLDOUT SPENT != EVALUATION COMPLETED != PROMOTION AUTHORIZED. Four events, recorded separately because they fail separately.

A fresh holdout is USED_IMMUTABLE from the durable holdout_model_facing_committed event onward, whatever happens next. RERUN IS FORBIDDEN after it; only operator RECOVERY remains. Prospective from S3Q.0; candidates 001 and 002 are sealed and are not reinterpreted.

An executable evaluation plan binds the EXACT pack, hidden-target-store and order-assignment identities, and truthfully declares performs_inference. A plan that cannot name its material carries a blocker instead of an approximation of it.
A completed evaluation whose durable evidence is missing is NOT a clean success. Artefacts are retained, never overwritten, and the answer is recovery, never a rerun.
A future EVALUATED_* state requires a valid portable evaluation receipt. A snapshot, a verifier constant, prose and a human sentence are each insufficient, in BOTH verdict directions.
A receipt is EVIDENCE OF AN OPERATION and never AUTHORITY FOR ANOTHER. No receipt grants TRAIN, EVAL, retry, promotion, activation, registry mutation, merge or release.
Token silence is ceremony hygiene, not cryptography. The confirmation string is a pure function of plan_hash and is neither secret nor unpredictable; PRE-GO surfaces simply must not materialise it.

An EVALUATED_* state is REDERIVED, never read: the portable receipt carries the body-free gate, bootstrap, empirical-status and serialisation-state evidence the decision was made from, and the PRODUCTION decide_eligibility is asked what they conclude. There is exactly one eligibility algorithm.
limitations: Gate thresholds are uncalibrated: thresholds_are_calibrated is false.
Every holdout is 36 synthetic tasks authored in one session by one author with no independent review; tool_call_schema has only 6.
Semantic leakage has never run. Every freshness and leakage result in this repository is exact or lexical, and a pure paraphrase would not be caught.
config_hash and plan_hash bind output_root_id, runtime and hardware evidence. Re-derive them on the executing host; never paste a recorded value in.
Candidate 001 was measured on eval-v2 and candidate 002 on eval-v3, with zero shared task instances. The two tables are not a head-to-head ranking.
The two candidates failed in opposite directions on the same axis and no midpoint is demonstrated: no ablation was run and none may be run against a spent holdout.
A candidate fitted under DISABLED is not directly comparable to candidate 001 or 002. What stays comparable is each candidate against its own simultaneously-measured baseline.
No model has been generated under the D38 instrument; every figure S3M.2 reports is synthetic or a re-reading of sealed metadata.
Two FinishReason members are unreachable in production, so their classification is a contract rather than a measurement.

Re-reading a sealed evaluation config now yields a different config_hash because the metric set entered the metric policy. Nothing sealed is affected and this must not be 'fixed' by exempting the metric set from identity.
The Kali runtimes are not claimed bytewise equivalent to the Windows runtime that produced candidate 001's adapter.

openai is a declared base dependency absent from the system interpreter; its absence alone fails 62 tests in three files. Environmental, reproduced at pristine HEAD, and never reconciled across interpreters by arithmetic.
Measurement is one host, CPU, one seed, one run per candidate. No repeat, no second host, no GPU, no dtype control arm.
Stale-state detection is PARTIAL: gitignored runtime artefacts are outside Git and a training or evaluation run that wrote only those could not be detected by diffing tracked paths.
config_hash and plan_hash bind output_root_id, so candidate 003's 6f9f470f and 414ce9e3 are valid for this host's output root only. Re-derive, never paste.
Train/eval render parity is established by shared enum identity and by test construction; production evaluation records no chat_render_policy_hash to compare.
The two S3O tokenizer tests skip on the authoritative interpreter, which has no transformers; the training venv has no pytest and installing either is forbidden.
Candidate 003's train-time validation is 12 rows of train-side steering material. It appears in no gate, is not held-out evidence, and is not comparable with candidate 001's or 002's numbers.
S3P is one host, one seed, one run, with no repeat and no ablation; deterministic_reproduction_claimed is false.

STALE_STATE_DETECTION remains PARTIAL. The portable receipt closes the gap for candidate 003's training history specifically; gitignored runtime artefacts are still outside Git and cannot be diffed in general.

The prospective spend boundary is deliberately EARLIER than proof that a forward pass ran. There is no atomic transaction between a durable local append and an external synchronous call, so a crash in that gap marks a holdout spent that a model may not have read. This is the chosen conservative error.
Candidates 001 and 002 have no portable evaluation receipt and never will. Their sealed milestone documents are their authority; the legacy exemption is closed and must not be widened.

D33 is unchanged and still OPEN: timeout_s is bound into the generation policy identity and enforced nowhere, so timeout_rate stays VACUOUS. Every S3Q.0 surface that reports the configured 300 s ceiling reports timeout_enforced false beside it.

expected_grader_executions remains an ESTIMATE (task_count * 6) and was deliberately NOT promoted to an exact identity: the real count depends on per-family grader registries and on how many arms produce scoreable output, neither knowable before the run.

receipt_hash proves payload integrity relative to the canonical bytes and nothing else: not human identity, not human authorisation, not a commit signature and not who ran the command. Authenticity comes from the receipt being tracked and from the control-plane hash chain.

The build-time adapter cross-check needs the runtime adapter tree to still exist on the host. Once the receipt is written the three-way snapshot/training-receipt/evaluation-receipt binding carries the history without it, but a receipt cannot be built later from a host whose run directory is gone.

Candidate 003 was measured ONCE, on one host, one CPU, one seed, with no repeat, no second host, no GPU and no dtype control arm. Every S3Q figure is a single observation with the paired baseline measured in the same run.

The observed paired mean delta is +0.044208 with a 95% interval of [-0.022359, +0.129413]. The interval does NOT exclude a regression, and the run is recorded as regression_not_excluded rather than as an improvement.

Candidate 003 is NOT ELIGIBLE on one deterministic gate: schema validity fell 9/9 -> 8/9. One task moved. A 36-task holdout cannot distinguish that from noise, and no ablation may be run against a spent holdout.

D28 and D33 bounded this measurement as they bound every earlier one: tool_call_validity_rate is VACUOUS so the six tool_call_schema tasks decided nothing, and timeout_rate is structurally vacuous. D29 bounds the refusal figures in BOTH directions.

The three security improvements are measured against candidate 003's own simultaneously-measured baseline on eval-v4. They are not comparable with candidate 001's or 002's security figures, which were measured on different holdouts.

m62.eval_receipt.3 has described exactly ONE real evaluation. Its Unicode handling, its four-verdict partition and its source split are proved against that one measurement plus synthetic non-vacuity; .2 remains proved over synthetic evidence only and stays a valid contract.

The measurement witness and the receipt establish REPOSITORY PROVENANCE: which tracked source state this measurement belongs to, fixed before the repair could move HEAD. They do NOT provide hardware or CPU-level cryptographic attestation, nothing here is signed, and no PKI is invented or implied.

The seal was built AFTER the measurement, from artefacts that already existed. That is the recovery this milestone performed and it is recorded as such: a receipt written after the fact proves what the artefacts say, not that nobody could have touched them between the run and the seal.

eval-v4 is spent and no ablation, retry or re-scoring of candidate 003 against it is possible in any circumstance. The fifth holdout D35 requires now exists: eval-v5 is FROZEN_UNUSED and must be spent once, after candidate 004 trains, never reused.

eval-v5 shares ZERO task instances with v2, v3 or v4, so a measurement on it is not a head-to-head comparison with candidates 001-003. Each candidate stays comparable only against its own simultaneously-measured baseline.

The session that authored eval-v5 has necessarily seen its bodies and is therefore disqualified from designing candidate 004. That firewall is PROCEDURAL - it is enforced by using a new session, and no check in this repository can detect a breach.

eval-v5's promotion_plan_hash binds output_root_id and is deliberately NOT part of the dataset identity: it differs between roots by design, while the manifest, the pack and the three set digests are identical in every root. Re-derive, never paste.

The spent eval-v4 semantic development audit is CLOSED, not waived: S3S.1 found those response bodies were never persisted, so S3R's MECHANISM_CONFIDENCE stays MEDIUM permanently. S3T.0 (D43) made the equivalent diagnosis available prospectively; it recovers candidate 003 not at all.
